metadata.name: Pushbutton with Pull-Down Resistor
metadata.description: Digital input circuit with tactile button and pull-down resistor for clean signal reading.

wires.description: Wire from Pico GPIO 14 to breadboard Bus6A-E. This is the digital input pin that reads button state.
Wire from Pico 3.3V pin to breadboard Bus5A-E. This provides HIGH voltage when button is pressed.
Wire from Pico ground pin to breadboard Bus11A-E. This completes the pull-down resistor path to ground.
